Description: Percentage of shader core resources that are occupied by the compute kernel
Name: Kernel Occupancy

Description: The occupancy level which the occupancy throttler is attempting to achieve.
Name: Occupancy Manager Target

Description: This Register Pressure Influence describes the way in which the Occupancy Manager Target is influenced due to GPR (General Purpose Register) pressure within the Apple GPU caches at a given point in time. If it is non-zero it denotes that the Apple GPU GPR caches are being over-utilized, and may be experiencing thrashing. The GPU believes it may be beneficial to decrease the total active number of SIMDGroups for more optimal cache behavior. If this Influence metric is seen to be driving the Occupancy Manager Target to be low and unexpectedly limiting the overall Occupancy, reducing the number of GPRs in use for the active shaders may provide performance gains
Name: Register Pressure Influence

Description: The Memory Request Stalls Influence metric describes the way in which the Occupancy Manager Target is influenced due to graphics memory stalls within the Apple GPU caches at a given point in time. If its value is non-zero it means memory requests are causing stalls in the memory hierarchy including GPU last level cache, MMU and main memory. The GPU believes it may be beneficial to decrease the total active number of SIMDGroups for more optimal cache behavior. If this Influence metric is seen to be driving the Occupancy Manager Target to be low and unexpectedly limiting the overall Occupancy, use strategies to reduce random memory access patterns to large buffers, use texture compression and texture mipmapping to reduce memory traffic.
Name: Memory Request Stalls Influence

Description: Measures how much memory, in gigabytes per second, are read by the GPU from a memory external to the GPU (potentially device memory)
Name: GPU Read Bandwidth

Description: Measures the time during which ALU work is executed as a percentage of peak ALU performance
Name: ALU Utilization
